subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should this issue be considered satisfied by a dedicated `openclaw skills lint` command, or must normal `skills list`, `skills check`, gateway status, and Web status also surface skipped `SKILL.md` diagnostics before close?
rationale: The remaining work is not just mechanical; it defines the user-facing diagnostic surface and whether lint-only validation is an acceptable first step for a silent-disappearance workflow.

options.title: Require Normal Visibility
options.body: Treat lint as useful but require skipped-skill diagnostics in the normal list/check/status/Web paths before closing this issue.

options.title: Accept Lint-First Scope
options.body: Land a corrected lint command as the first fix and track normal status/Web diagnostics as a separate follow-up.

options.title: Limit To Manual Validation
options.body: Decide that a dedicated validation command is enough and explicitly narrow the issue away from automatic status/list/Web warnings.

recommendation.title: Require Normal Visibility
recommendation.body: Treat lint as useful but require skipped-skill diagnostics in the normal list/check/status/Web paths before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest visible history across skills docs/parser-adjacent surfaces and prior issue-scoping comments for related Markdown/skill validation work.
